text.tspan: FIELD REFERENCE / EXPERIMENTAL
WORLD: roll d6, resolve matching event; cards are a lookup set with replacement.
INCOME: +3 each; pay ceil(debt / 3), plus 1 for logistics above 1; credit tightening +1 if debt.
NEGOTIATE: 3 actions shared across bids and later actions. Lowest payout wins; relationship, then submission
order break ties.
BID: 1 action +1 escrow; full cargo and logistics reserve. Losing escrow refunds. Signed consortium shares each
total 100%.
ACTIONS: alternate one action. Acquire price; Sell price-1; Influence 2; Network 2; Audit 1; Pressure 3;
Transport; Refinance; Pass.
DELIVERY: Transport action pays only on completed delivery. Deadline failure costs 3 liability and escrow;
resources release.
ENFORCEMENT: d6 <= investigation confiscates first unreserved cargo, fine 2, lose 1 reputation.
REFRESH: replenish each good by player count (cap 12); price -1 if stock >=8; rotate first house; reset 3
actions.
FINAL: floor((money + cargo tokens - debt)/2) + prestige + countries with relation >=2 + objective - 2 per
investigation.
TIES: prestige; lower investigation; cash; seating order. Debt <=9, investigation <=6, relationships <=3.
TENDERS: choose country by shuffled country lookup with replacement, cargo d6 pairs, quantity odd/even 1/2.
Ceiling = quantity * current cargo price +4 + floor(country demand/2). Deadline=min(8,round+1). Logistics 1;
relationship 0.
Legal if stability >=2, otherwise gray +2 investigation on delivery. Prestige 1 for qty1, 2 for qty2. Generate
players+2 each refresh.
SELECTION: draw each lookup with replacement; shuffle between draws. A computer seed is an optional digital
replay enhancement.
PRESSURE: stability -2, demand +1, investigation +2, reputation -1. At stability <=1 sanctions block every house
transport.
SUCCESSION at stability0: leader index +1, stability3, sanctions this round; reduce all house relationships by1
(minimum0).
INSOLVENCY: cash first; debt up to9; remaining loss reduces prestige to0. No bankruptcy removal in engine v1.
ROUND BOOKKEEPING: reserve committed cargo face-down in named tender envelopes. Return capacity on settlement;
recycle used cargo.
NO PRIVATE EXCLUSIVITY: joining a consortium never blocks other bids or country access. Unsigned promises are
not enforceable.
PLAYTEST ONLY: private tenders, unique leader abilities, active contact decks, and physical bookkeeping
usability are not validated.
